QuestInfo.name: I Just Want To Be Pretty
QuestInfo.0: Natalie had an inferiority complex about her looks.
QuestInfo.1: Natalie wants to become prettier and has decided to get plastic surgery. She is trying to figure out who she will be using from the two doctors, #bDr. Feeble#k and  #bDenma.#k Go see them for Natalie and check them out.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta asked the plastic surgeons for their philosophies for Natalie and recommended the best doctor for her.

0.0: I'm ugly, aren't I? Just so hideous...\r\n#L0##b Umm... Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.#l\n#k
0.1: See, you can't even give me a straight answer. You know, I wasn't this ugly before. I took some medicine and it had...strange side effects.  I wonder how the world treats you when you're pretty.\r\n#L0##bIt's not so different, really...#l\n#k
0.2: Well, well, well... aren't WE the high and mighty ones? Well too bad! I don't care. I'm going to be pretty, no matter what it takes, and YOU'RE going to help.

yes.0: There are two Plastic Surgeons in Henesys: #bDr. Feeble#k and #bDenma the Owner#k. This decision will be something I will have to live with for the rest of my life, so I'm going to leave it up to you. I hate consultations...

no.0: We live in a cruel world! Only pretty girls get what they want.

default.0: Which doctor is better? #bDr. Feeble#k or #bDenma the Owner#k?
